fields: h, intro, items [{t, d, hold, link, bay}]. bay (optional): plan, receive, qualify, join, test, clean (default from the step's words).
best_for: ShopRoute shows a fabrication sequence as the route a spool takes through the shop, drawn as a floor plan on a limestone sheet: one bay per step (three across, the second row returning right to left as a U-shaped shop runs) with its plan furniture, one route line through every bay with a stop per step, a gate after a hold point, and a ringed stop and tag for each witness point.

items.d: Agreed before material is ordered: standards, inspection extent, records, hold and witness points.
Each PP lot checked against its certificate and logged.
Test joints made and accepted before any production joint. Witness point.
Each joint numbered and logged with its parameters; visual examination. Rejects cut out, renumbered. Witness point.
Pressure test, slope survey and dead leg check. Witness point.
Flushed and rinsed with PW before factory acceptance testing. Dossier indexed by joint number, updated with field joints.
